responses.question_text: When faced with a complex project, how do you approach organizing your tasks?

selected_answer.answer_text: I outline the main tasks and try to estimate how long each will take, but I might miss some details.

responses.question_text: How do you handle feedback or data when evaluating your work?

selected_answer.answer_text: I listen to feedback, but I often struggle to relate it to my work or make changes.

responses.question_text: When designing visuals or user experiences, how do you ensure they meet user needs?

selected_answer.answer_text: I try to consider user preferences, but I mainly rely on my intuition when designing.

responses.question_text: How do you address potential risks in a project?

selected_answer.answer_text: I identify potential risks early and develop contingency plans to mitigate them.

responses.question_text: How do you communicate updates to your team during a project?

selected_answer.answer_text: I rarely share updates, assuming others will figure things out on their own.

responses.question_text: How do you approach creating written content for your projects?

selected_answer.answer_text: I carefully craft my content, ensuring clarity and relevance to my audience.
